arguments.code:
token = login_resp['access_token']
current_year = datetime.datetime.now().year

recs = all_recs
# Fetch song details and filter for genre containing 'r&b' and release date in current_year
song_details = []
for r in recs:
    sid = r['song_id']
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_details.append(sd)

# inspect genre and release_date distribution
rnb_year_songs = []
for sd in song_details:
    genre = sd.get('genre')
    release_date = sd.get('release_date')
    # Parse release year if possible
    rel_year = None
    if isinstance(release_date, str) and release_date:
        rel_year = int(release_date.split('-')[0])
    genre_norm = (genre or '').strip().lower()
    is_rnb = ('r&b' in genre_norm) or (genre_norm in ['rnb','r&b'])
    if is_rnb and rel_year == current_year:
        rnb_year_songs.append({
            'song_id': sd['song_id'],
            'title': sd['title'],
            'artists': [a['name'] for a in sd.get('artists', [])],
            'genre': sd.get('genre'),
            'release_date': sd.get('release_date'),
            'album_title': sd.get('album_title')
        })

print('Total recommendations:', len(recs))
print('Total song_details fetched:', len(song_details))
print('Current year:', current_year)
print('R&B + year matches:', len(rnb_year_songs))
print('R&B matches sample:', rnb_year_songs[:10])

# Also print unique genres seen (top 20)
from collections import Counter
genres = [sd.get('genre') for sd in song_details]
ctr = Counter([g for g in genres])
print('Unique genres count:', len(ctr))
print('Top genres:', ctr.most_common(10))
